faq.title: Questions dispensaries ask

items.q: Do you only work with dispensaries in NYC?
items.a: Our primary focus is licensed dispensaries in New York City, including Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and Staten Island. We can also support licensed cannabis retailers in other New York and US markets.

items.q: Can you optimize our Dutchie menu for SEO?
items.a: Yes. We audit how your Dutchie menu is connected to your website, whether its category and product pages are discoverable, and how the menu supports your local and organic search visibility.

items.q: Do you optimize Google Business Profiles for dispensaries?
items.a: Yes. Google Maps visibility is a core part of our dispensary SEO work. We review profile categories, services, business information, reviews, photos, posts and local relevance signals.

items.q: Can dispensaries use SEO when advertising is restricted?
items.a: Yes. SEO helps dispensaries reduce their reliance on restricted advertising channels. Organic search, Google Maps, menu searches and AI-assisted discovery can connect licensed retailers with people already searching for nearby products and stores.

Our work is designed for licensed cannabis businesses. We avoid unsupported health claims, review platform policies and structure content around factual business, product and location information. Final legal and regulatory compliance remains the responsibility of the retailer and its legal advisers.

items.q: What is GEO or AI search optimization?
items.a: Generative Engine Optimization, or GEO, improves how clearly AI systems can understand your dispensary, locations, products and expertise. It builds on traditional SEO using structured information, credible content and consistent business signals. No agency can guarantee an AI citation or recommendation.

items.q: How is this different from a regular SEO agency?
items.a: We understand the search challenges specific to licensed dispensaries: local competition, platform restrictions, Dutchie menu indexing, migrations, Google Business Profile management and cannabis content review. The strategy is built around these issues rather than adapted from a generic local SEO package.

items.q: How quickly can dispensary SEO produce results?
items.a: Technical fixes and Google Business Profile updates may be reflected within several weeks. Meaningful organic growth usually takes longer and depends on your current website, competition, location, authority and implementation scope. We use Google Search Console and GA4 to measure actual progress.

items.q: Do you help with Dutchie Pro migrations?
items.a: Yes. We help plan SEO-safe migrations from Dutchie Plus, Dutchie iFrame and legacy setups to Dutchie Pro. This can include URL mapping, redirect planning, indexation checks, GA4 and Search Console tracking, technical review and post-launch monitoring.

The scope depends on your market, website, Dutchie setup, number of locations and growth goals. We begin with a visibility review and then recommend a focused project or monthly program based on the work actually required.
